expectations.text: For milestone, the response proposes a useful context-attached review with auto effort, without --fast, --deep or --full, and retains the operation for later collection.
expectations.evidence: B.md:13-30 proposes auto review with attached context and no effort/freshness flags; B.md:32 retains the operation, with collection specified at B.md:143-151.

expectations.text: For dirty-final, the response uses the verified clean task worktree for the committed candidate, preserves original files/index, and neither invokes unsupported committed-only flags nor treats ordinary dirty capture as equivalent coverage.
expectations.evidence: B.md:36-46 selects the verified task-only clean worktree, rejects unsupported committed-only collection, explains isolation, and prohibits modification of original files/index.

expectations.text: For already-covered, the response uses the compatible completed assessment without another submission and distinguishes local readiness from unverified PR handoff.
expectations.evidence: B.md:66-68 explicitly reuses compatible completed coverage without submission and states that local readiness does not establish hosted-review, CI or merge readiness.

expectations.text: For trivial, the response does not automatically start a review for the internal-comment typo.
expectations.evidence: B.md:72-74 explicitly declines automatic review and any command or context submission.

expectations.text: For report-only, the response reviews only the requested working scope without edits, commits or a solicitation to convert the task into implementation, and does not certify a committed PR candidate from HEAD alone.
expectations.evidence: B.md:78-96 reviews requested uncommitted changes without edits, commits or PR preparation; B.md:99 requires reporting then stopping without solicitation. No HEAD-based candidate certification appears.

expectations.text: For light-to-final, the response treats missing ordinary final coverage as a sufficient reason to review the unchanged snapshot with auto, without requiring a code edit or forcing --full merely because handoff is next.
expectations.evidence: B.md:103-117 proceeds with ordinary auto final review because coverage is missing despite an unchanged snapshot, explicitly omitting --fast, --deep and --full.

expectations.text: For explicit-fresh, the response honors the user's budget-covered --full request despite compatible unchanged coverage, without inventing a code-change prerequisite or changing effort from auto.
expectations.evidence: B.md:124-138 honors the within-budget request using --full despite unchanged compatible coverage; B.md:130 explicitly preserves auto effort.

expectations.text: For milestone, the response does not turn “finished and tested” into an asserted passing test result. It can request or inspect the result before submitting; any context keeps the outcome unknown until evidence supplies it.
expectations.evidence: B.md:25 explicitly states that test names and outcomes were not supplied and passing results are not established.
